title: scope
description: A scope file (SEC-010, SEC-011, SEC-012): written by a person, read by the CLI, never created or edited by it. Strict JSON: unknown keys are invalid here, duplicate keys are rejected by the parser (check-contract.py parses strictly). targets absent means any target of this tool; a selector matches its key exactly or, by default, as a subtree on the boundaries / ! # : @. $defs/refusal is error.details.scope of an E_FORBIDDEN refusal (CLI-014).

destinations.description: Where deliver may send content (contract.json scope.destination_match). A destination containing :// matches the same scheme and host and a path at or below the granted path; any other destination (email address, handle, channel id) matches exactly, and as a prefix only when it ends with /, at / boundaries; @ : # ! are ordinary characters here.

outputs.description: Absolute directories where new local files may be created (artifact).

roots.description: Absolute directories whose existing files may be overwritten (persist).

selector.description: A target selector: subtree (default) or exact match on the target key.

max_operations.description: Confirmed operations allowed under this scope, counted from the journal.

refusal.description: error.details.scope when a write is refused locally (CLI-014, SEC-010): why, which file, what is missing and an example grant for the person to adjust and save.

allOf.description: A missing or unreadable file has no scope id.
An insufficient scope says what is missing.

missing.description: What the request needs beyond the current scope. Known keys are typed; a tool may add others.

outputs.description: New files whose directory is not under the scope's outputs.

roots.description: Existing files the command would overwrite, not under the scope's roots.
